name: Namekian Vigilant Mastery
Text: [CONSTANT]: Any attacks performed by your MP deal +1 life card. [INSTANT] POWER: Use when you would Rejuvenate any number of cards during combat. Banish them instead to search your Life Deck for a Styled or Named Drill and place it into play.

name: Blue Preventive Mastery
Text: [DEFENSE] POWER: Use only on the first attack your opponent performs in combat. Prevent all damage from this attack. You may discard a card from your hand. If you do, this attack deals no damage. POWER: The next time one of your opponent's effects would raise their anger this combat, change that amount to 0.

name: Black Ominous Mastery
Text: (You cannot win by MPPV) [CONSTANT]: Your Styled attacks deal +1 stage and +1 life card. [INSTANT] POWER: Use when one of your effects discards or banishes the last card in your opponent's hand. Advance or lower your MP 1 level. POWER: Banish the top 2 cards of your opponent's discard pile. The next time one of your Styled effects discards a card from your opponent's hand during combat, the card is chosen at random.

name: Saiyan Surging Mastery
Text: (You cannot win by MPPV) [CONSTANT]: Your Styled attacks gain "Raise your anger 1." At the start of the Discard Step, if your MP advanced a level this turn, lower your MP 1 level. [INSTANT] POWER: Use when an effect lowers your MP 1 or more levels. Draw a card. POWER: Your next Styled attack this combat deals +X life cards. X = your MP's level.

name: Red Primal Mastery
Text: [CONSTANT]: Your attacks cost -1 stage (this effect cannot lower a cost to 0). [INSTANT] POWER: Use when you would use a critical damage effect during combat. Raise your anger 2 instead. POWER: Rejuvenate X. X = your current anger level.

name: Orange Cunning Mastery
Text: [CONSTANT]: Your attacks deal +1 life card. Whenever a Drill you own would be discarded due to your MP changing levels, you may Rejuvenate it instead. [INSTANT] POWER: Use when you would use a critical damage effect during combat. Search your Life Deck for a Styled Still and place it into play instead. [POWER]: Rejuvenate a Drill from your discard pile.

name: Red Spinal Fracture
Text: [ATTACK] Physical attack. Lower your opponent's anger 2. If you have banished cards from your Life Deck this turn, Unpreventable. DAMAGE: 6 Stages. HIT: Rejuvenate after use.

name: Black Android Visage
Text: (Villains only.) POWER: Banish the top 5 cards of your opponent's discard pile. If there are no cards in your opponent's discard pile, discard a card from your opponent's hand. [ANDROID]: If your opponent has not discarded a card this action, discard a card from your opponent's hand. (Rejuvenate after use.)

name: Namekian Ward
Text: (If this card is banished by one of your effects, search your discard pile for a Drill and place it into play.) [DEFENSE]: Stops a physical attack. Lower your opponent's anger 1.

name: Red Palm Charge
Text: [ATTACK] 2: Energy attack. Search your discard pile for up to 2 Styled cards and place them on the top or bottom of your discard pile. [DESPERATION]: Lower your opponent's anger 2. DAMAGE: 6 life cards. HIT: Rejuvenate 2. (Banish after use.)

name: Blue Dookie
Text: [INSTANT] POWER: Use after taking damage from an attack you prevented from a non-Endurance source or after your opponent's attack deals no damage. That attack loses all HIT effects. If that attack dealt no damage, draw a card. (Banish after use.)

name: Orange Bang
Text: [ATTACK] 2: Energy attack. Use a critical damage effect. DAMAGE: 4 life cards.

name: Orange Flowing Drill
Text: (Orange Cunning Mastery only. Limit 1 per deck.) [INSTANT] POWER: Use after performing a successful Styled attack. That attack gains: 'HIT: If you control 5 or less Drills, search the bottom 5 cards of your Life Deck for a Drill and place it into play. Shuffle the remaining cards into your Life Deck.'

name: Saiyan Wallop
Text: (Saiyan Surging Mastery only.) [ATTACK] Physical attack. Lower your opponent's anger 2. DAMAGE: 5 stages. HIT: Raise your anger 2.

name: Saiyan Pacing Drill
Text: (This Drill is not discarded when changing levels.) [CONSTANT] Your Styled attacks deal +1 life card and +1 stage. [INSTANT] POWER: Use after your MP changes levels. If your MP advanced a level this turn, Rejuvenate 3. If your MP lowered a level this turn, gain 5 stages.

name: Blue Exalted Defense
Text: (Blue Preventative Mastery only.) [DEFENSE] POWER: Prevent all damage from an attack. If you have discarded a card from your hand this combat, this attack deals no damage. Search the top 5 cards of your Life Deck for a Setup or Drill and place it into play. Put the remaining cards at the bottom of your Life Deck in any order. (Banish after use.)

name: Black Empowered Ki Push
Text: (Black Ominous Mastery only.) [ATTACK] 2: Energy attack. Focused. Raise your anger 2. [DESPERATION]: You may lower your MP 1 level. If you do, this attack deals +7 life cards. DAMAGE: 4 life cards. (Banish after use.)

name: Orange Revelry Drill
Text: (You cannot win by MPPV if you use this Drill's [CONSTANT] Power.) [CONSTANT]: Whenever your MP changes levels, choose up to X Drills you control. Those Drills are not discarded. X = your MP's level.

name: Black Piracy Drill
Text: (This Drill is not discarded when advancing a level.) [CONSTANT]: Your attacks deal +1 life card. After one of your effects discards a card from your opponent's hand, banish the bottom 2 cards of your opponent's discard pile.

name: Red Pressure Drill
Text: [CONSTANT]: Your opponent's attacks deal -1 life card. [INSTANT] POWER: Use at the start of your turn. Foresee 1.

name: Blue Flying Kick
Text: [ATTACK] Physical attack. Raise your anger 2. [MAJIN]: Shuffle all copies of this card from your discard pile into your Life Deck. DAMAGE: AT +3 stages. (Rejuvenate after use.)

name: Namekian Ki Point
Text: [ATTACK] 2: Energy attack. DAMAGE: 5 life cards. HIT: Search your Life Deck for a Styled Drill and place it into play. (Banish after use.)

name: Saiyan Precise Shot
Text: [ATTACK] 2: Energy attack. [ANDROID]: Banish an opponent's Setup, Drill, or Ally. DAMAGE: 5 life cards.

name: Buu - Playful
Text: (Your Life Deck cannot include Allies not named "Bee" or "Hercule".) POWER: [ATTACK] Physical attack. Raise your anger 1. DAMAGE: 2 stages. HIT: Search each player's Life Deck for a non-Styled card and destroy them.

name: Buu - Durable
Text: [CONSTANT]: Your attacks deal +1 stage and +1 life card. POWER: [ATTACK] Physical attack. Search your Life Deck for an Ally and place it into play at 3 stages above 0 DAMAGE: 4 stages. HIT: Raise your anger 1. Lower your opponent's anger 1.

name: Buu - In Control
Text: (When you reach this level, Rejuvenate all Allies from yor discard pile and Banished Zone.) [CONSTANT]: Your attacks deal +1 stage and +1 life card. [POWER: [ATTACK] Physical attack. If Bee is in play, Focused. If Hercule is in play, Unpreventable. Raise your anger 1. DAMAGE: 5 stages. HIT: Search your discard pile for a card and Rejuvenate it.

name: Buu - Fighting Fit
Text: (You cannot win by MPPV.) [CONSTANT]: Your attacks deal +2 stages and +2 life cards. POWER: [ATTACK] Physical attack. Rejuvenate all Allies from your discard pile and Banished Zone. Lower a player's anger 1. DAMAGE: 5 stages. HIT: Search your Life Deck for an Ally and place it into play at 3 stages above 0.

name: Buu's Slumber
Text: (Heroes only. If this card is in your discard pile, you may banish it as an action to lower your opponent's anger 2.) POWER: Search your discard pile for up to 2 cards and shuffle them into your Life Deck. (Rejuvenate after use.)

name: Bergamo - Of Universe 9
Text: [CONSTANT]: After taking damage, raise your anger 1. [INSTANT] POWER: Use when entering combat. Search the top 7 cards of your Life Deck for a Named card and place it into your hand. If that card wasa Setup, Drill, or Ally, you may place it into play. Shuffle the remaining cards into your Life Deck.

name: Bergamo - Eldest Brother
Text: (When you reach this level, place all [ALIEN] Allies from your Banished Zone on top of your Life Deck.) POWER: [ATTACK] 2: Energy attack. Raise your anger 2. DAMAGE: 5 life cards. HIT: Search your discard pile for a Named card and place it into your hand. If that card was a Setup, Drill, or Ally, you may place it into play.

name: Bergamo - The Crusher
Text: [INSTANT] POWER: Use when entering combat. Search your Life Deck, discard pile, or Banished Zone for a 'Trio of Danger' Ally and play it. POWER: [ATTACK] 2: Energy attack. Focsued. If Basil is in play, destroy the top 3 cards of your opponent's Life Deck. If Lavender is in play, banish 3 cards from your opponent's discard pile. DAMAGE: 7 life cards.

name: Bergamo - Huge
Text: [CONSTANT]: When one of your 'Trio of Danger' Allies would leave play, you may choose to have it stay in play instead. POWER: Search your Life Deck, discard pile, or Banished Zone for a Named card and place it into your hand. If that card was a Setup, Drill, or Ally, you may place it into play.

name: Basil - Trio of Danger
Text: (Bergamo only. This card is considered named. You may use this Power regardless of your MP's power stage.) [CONSTANT]: Attacks performed by your MP gain 'If this attack is stopped, destroy the top card of your opponent's Life Deck.' [DEFENSE] POWER: Prevent all damage from an energy attack.

name: Lavender - Trio of Danger
Text: (Bergamo only. This card is considered named. You may use this Power regardless of your MP's power stage.) [CONSTANT]: After taking damage, banish the top card of your opponent's discard pile. [DEFENSE] POWER: Prevent all damage from an physical attack.

name: Bergamo's Dangers' Triangle
Text: [ATTACK] 2: Energy attack. Unpreventable. If Basil is in play, Unstoppable. If Lavender is in play, banish 2 cards from your opponent's discard pile. DAMAGE: 5 life cards. (Banish after use.)

name: Bergamo's Wolfgang Penetrator
Text: [ATTACK]: 2: Energy attack. You may search your Life Deck or discard pile for an [ALIEN] ally and place it into play. If you do not, search your Banished Zone for a 'Trio of Danger' Ally and place it into play. DAMAGE: 5 life cards.
